**About Aery Aviation LLC**

Aery Aviation, LLC is an aviation services organization whose focus is on the engineering, certification, and production associated with aircraft modifications. Our team has significant experience spanning everything from single engine ISR aircraft for government utilization to widebody VVIP interior completions. From design to delivery, Aery provides turnkey, bespoke solutions for our clientele.

**About the role**

Located in Newport News, VA, Aery Aviation is seeking an experienced **Project Accountant** to join our Finance and Accounting team in our Newport News office. This role will support project-based accounting across government, aviation, maintenance, engineering, modification, and special mission programs.

The ideal candidate will have strong accounting fundamentals, experience supporting contract or project-based businesses, and preferably prior exposure to **government contracting accounting**, including cost tracking, labor allocation, billing support, indirect cost awareness, and compliance-oriented documentation.

This position is in-office 5 days a week - not remote or hybrid.

**Who We Are Looking For**

The successful candidate will be:

- Detail-oriented and highly organized.
- Comfortable working across departments.
- Accountable for accuracy and follow-through.
- Able to identify problems and recommend practical solutions.
- Professional, discreet, and dependable.
- Comfortable supporting a growing company with evolving processes.
- Able to balance accounting discipline with operational urgency.

**What You Will Be Doing**

The Project Accountant will be responsible for supporting accurate accounting, reporting, and financial tracking for assigned projects and contracts. Responsibilities include:

- Track project costs, labor, materials, subcontractor costs, travel, and other direct project expenses.
- Support project setup, customer/job coding, class tracking, cost codes, and contract-specific accounting requirements.
- Assist with monthly project financial reviews, including budget-to-actual analysis and variance explanations.
- Support government contract billing, commercial billing, and customer invoicing as assigned.
- Work closely with Program Managers, Operations, Business Development, and Finance leadership to ensure project financial information is accurate and timely.
- Review labor charging, timekeeping data, and cost allocations for consistency with project requirements.
- Support work-in-process accounting, project accruals, revenue recognition, and cost-to-complete analysis.
- Assist with tracking project profitability, gross margin, backlog, and contract performance.
- Help maintain documentation required for internal controls, audits, contract reviews, and customer support.
- Assist with accounts receivable follow-up, billing backup, invoice documentation, and customer reporting.
- Support monthly close activities related to assigned programs and projects.
- Identify accounting discrepancies, coding issues, missing documentation, or process gaps and help resolve them.
- Assist with improving project accounting processes, reporting tools, and internal coordination between Accounting and Operations.

**You Must Have**

- Minimum 5 years of accounting experience, preferably in project accounting, job cost accounting, contract accounting, or government contracting.
- Strong understanding of general accounting principles.
- Experience with project/job cost tracking and financial reporting.
- Proficiency with accounting systems and Microsoft Excel.
- Ability to work with detailed financial data and reconcile costs to supporting documentation.
- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
- Ability to communicate clearly with accounting, operations, and program management personnel.
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
- Ability to handle confidential financial and contract information professionally.Job Requirements

**Preferred Qualifications**

- Experience in aviation, aerospace, defense, engineering, manufacturing, maintenance, or government contracting.
- Experience with QuickBooks Online or similar accounting software.
- Familiarity with timekeeping, labor distribution, and project-based billing systems.
- Understanding of WIP, inventory, project accruals, and revenue recognition concepts.
- Experience supporting audits, contract reviews, or compliance documentation.
- Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, and budget-to-actual reporting.

**Preferred Government Accounting Experience**

Government accounting experience is strongly preferred, including familiarity with one or more of the following:

- FAR-based contract environments.
- Cost-reimbursable, fixed-price, or time-and-material contract structures.
- Direct vs. indirect cost treatment.
- Labor distribution and timekeeping requirements.
- Project/job cost accounting.
- Government billing support.
- DCAA-style documentation expectations.
- Contract funding, ceiling values, modifications, and period-of-performance tracking.
- Indirect rates, overhead, G&A, and fringe cost concepts.

**Education**

- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field preferred.
- Equivalent experience may be considered.
- CPA is **not required**.

For Aery Aviation, the question isn’t: “Can we?” When others are limited in the common approach, Aery Aviation jumps into higher gear asking, “How can we do this?” and then proceeds into problem-solving for customers. This is what customers appreciate most about Aery Aviation - avid tenacity. It’s not cookie cutter production that Aery Aviation is cultivating; it is projects that inspire the Aery Aviation work-family to come together and brainstorm, excited to come to work every day because there is always something inventive and interesting to work on.

We offer the right candidate the chance to join a forward-thinking organization, supported by a competitive compensation and benefits package. Learn more about Aery Aviation, LLC at **www.aeryaviation.com**.

Balfour Beatty US is an industry-leading provider of general contracting, at-risk construction management and design-build services for public and private sector clients across the nation. Performing heavy civil and vertical construction, our teams build the unique structures and infrastructure that play an important role in how people live, work, learn and play in our communities. Our teammates have an instinctive passion for innovating that is fueled by a relentless curiosity, a drive to employ lean practices and processes and the determination to find a better way. Through Zero Harm®, we are challenging the construction industry’s assumptions about safety. We believe that no level of harm should come to anyone as a result of our business.
  
  
Consistently ranked among the nation’s largest building contractors by Engineering News-Record, our US business is a subsidiary of London-based Balfour Beatty plc (LSE: BBY).
  
  
Our Benefits
  
  
Balfour Beatty offers employees a comprehensive compensation and benefit package:
  
  
Medical, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance
  
  
Health Savings Account
  
  
401(k) with company match
  
  
Paid time off
  
  
Tuition Assistance
  
  
Employee Referral Bonus
  
  
And more!
  
  
**Summary**
At Balfour Beatty we are seeking a Project Accountant to work on large, ground-up, mixed-use construction projects. This is an in-person position. The individual will be working either on-site at their respective project or in the Balfour Beatty office (Falls Church or Richmond depending on location).
  
  
The Project Accountant is the primary accounting and administrative support for a construction project, from project startup through final closeout. Serves as the liaison between the jobsite and the finance department, ensuring all accounting standard operating procedures are followed at the jobsite. Performs activities related to contracts, bonds, insurance, payables, liens, billings, payroll/cost/budget reports for the jobsite management team.
  
  
**Essential Functions**
**Project Accounting**

- Provides information to appropriate people regarding project status (i.e. PFR, job cost reports to owners, etc.) and communicates between the field and corporate office.
- Ensures job cost reports and accounts receivable reports are accurate at all times and in balance with the general ledger.
- Ensures all information in the project cost system and underlying supporting records are properly classified in a manner that best facilitates the use of the information.
- Understands the nature of the project cost systems and the information processed. Bring issues to the attention of Financial Services and the Project Manager for assistance and further evaluation.
- Enters all financial paperwork into the accounting system to ensure timely and accurate job cost information. This includes owner and sub change orders, owner billings, budget transfers, subcontractor pay requirements, payroll and A/P invoices.
- Processes all miscellaneous and blanket purchase order invoices in a timely manner and ensure supporting paperwork is attached, correct and approved.
- Collaborates with key people to process monthly billings to owners and runs projected final cost report.

**Subcontractor Management**

- Processes subcontractor monthly pay requisitions and ensures all supporting attachments are correct. Follows up with subcontractors to obtain any missing documents so subcontractors are paid on time.
- Maintains subcontractor/vendor purchasing register. Verify all subcontractors have current insurance certificates by checking the insurance/held check database and the fully executed contract prior to the subcontractor starting work.

**Project Administration**

- Implements and maintains a filing system according to company guidelines. Establishes and maintains files required for company Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and Minority Business Entity (MBE) requirements.
- Performs various administrative tasks for the jobsite, including: handling incoming/outgoing mail and overnight mail, establishing new supplier accounts, purchasing office supplies, preparing payroll, answering telephones, filing, etc.

**Promote Customer Relations**

- Builds effective relationships with customers, design team, subcontractors, suppliers, and user groups that reflect and support company core values and meets or exceeds the customer’s expectations.

**Culture, Leadership and Employee Development**

- Promotes our Creed. Communicates our vision and purpose through Service, Talent, and Choices.
- Serves as a role model and promotes professional behavior.
- Participates in company training programs and commits to self development.
- Perform miscellaneous duties as assigned.

**Working Conditions**

- The majority of work is completed on job sites in an office trailer or in an existing structure. Due to daily condition changes on construction projects, when employees are outside of the office trailer or structure, they must wear appropriate personal protective equipment as required by the company's safety policies and as required for weather conditions.
- The project team and/or team member may need to move to other projected work geographic locations, if necessary.

**Education, Experience, And Knowledge**

- Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in Accounting or related field preferred (or equivalent experience) and 2 + years of experience, preferably in the construction industry. Depending upon the project size, scope, and complexity the years of experience may vary.
- Demonstrates proficiency in basic accounting principles.
- Demonstrates solid customer service skills and verbal/written skills.
- Demonstrates the ability to be a team player and function in a fast-paced, changing environment.
- Demonstrates proficiency using a personal computer (PC) and company communication tools, such as email, internet, and Microsoft products (e.g., Word, Excel, Office, Outlook).

Balfour Beatty is an equal opportunity employer that recognizes the value of a diverse workforce. All qualified individuals will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other criteria protected by federal, state or local law.

The

t reports to the Senior Manager, Project Accounting. - Perform Project Accounting for various construction project types including interior, capital building renovations and development work within the Job Cost Module of the Financial Accounting system. To include managing project budgets, ensuring cost control, application of costs to budget line-items and to ensure adherence with all Company policies, procedures, and internal control requirements.

- Other duties as assigned.

:**

- Bachelor’s degree in accounting preferred; Accounting certificate with proven experience considered
- 3-8 years’ experience in accounting, including some financial management
- Knowledge and experience in real estate or construction a plus
- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

- Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills
- Proven ability to both work within existing systems and processes and to create new workflows
- Strong oral and written communication skills to clearly and effectively convey issues, reports, and other deliverables

**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

Afton Scientific is a privately held, PE-backed sterile fill-finish contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) headquartered in Charlottesville, Virginia. For over 20 years, Afton has provided aseptic manufacturing services for biologics and small-molecule injectables, supporting clients from clinical trials through commercial supply. The company operates FDA-inspected, cGMP-compliant manufacturing facilities and is currently executing a $200M+ expansion (Avon IV) that will add high-speed isolator-based filling lines and significantly increase capacity.

Afton serves pharmaceutical and biotech companies across oncology, metabolic/obesity therapeutics, immunology, infectious disease, and rare disease markets. Our location in central Virginia places us within a one-day drive of approximately 50% of the U.S. population, a strategic advantage for cold-chain and time-sensitive pharmaceutical logistics.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

Afton Scientific is seeking a detail-oriented, analytically minded recent graduate from the University of Virginia’s McIntire School of Commerce (or equivalent program) with a degree in Accounting, Finance, or Commerce to join the Finance team as a Staff Accountant. This position reports directly to the Financial Controller and works closely with the CFO, providing foundational exposure to the full accounting cycle within a regulated pharmaceutical manufacturing environment.

The Staff Accountant will be a core contributor to Afton’s lean finance organization, performing general ledger accounting, financial statement preparation, cost accounting, and month-end close activities using SAP Business One (SAP B1). This is a ground-floor opportunity to build your career in an environment where your work product has immediate, visible impact on financial reporting, operational decision-making, and compliance. You will gain direct experience with U.S. GAAP, ERP systems, cost of goods sold analysis, audit support, and pharmaceutical-specific accounting requirements—skills that translate directly to careers in public accounting, corporate finance, controllership, or consulting.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**General Ledger & Financial Reporting**

•        Prepare and post journal entries for month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes in accordance with U.S. GAAP

•        Perform monthly balance sheet account reconciliations and investigate variances to resolution

•        Assist in the preparation and review of financial statements, including income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow statement

•        Support revenue recognition activities under ASC 606, including milestone tracking and contract analysis for CDMO client engagements

•        Maintain the general ledger chart of accounts and ensure transactions are properly classified

**Cost Accounting & COGS Analysis**

•        Support cost of goods sold (COGS) analysis, including standard cost development, bill of materials review, material and labor variance analysis, and inventory valuation

•        Assist with work-in-process (WIP) accounting and batch cost tracking for sterile fill-finish manufacturing campaigns

•        Reconcile inventory accounts and investigate discrepancies between physical counts and the general ledger

•        Assist in developing and maintaining standard cost models as Afton scales production capacity through the Avon IV expansion

**Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable**

•        Process accounts payable and accounts receivable transactions within SAP B1, including invoice coding, three-way matching, and payment processing

•        Prepare AP aging schedules and AR collection reports for management review

•        Process employee expense reports and corporate credit card reconciliations

•        Assist with vendor onboarding, W-9 collection, and 1099 reporting

**Audit, Tax & Compliance Support**

•        Support the annual external audit by preparing schedules, work papers, and supporting documentation in accordance with GAAS

•        Assist with sales and use tax filings and research state and local tax compliance questions as needed

•        Help build and maintain internal controls documentation to support segregation of duties and audit readiness

•        Ensure accounting processes comply with cGMP documentation standards where applicable

**Fixed Assets & Capital Projects**

•        Maintain the fixed asset ledger, including capitalization, depreciation schedules, and disposal entries

•        Support capital asset tracking related to the Avon IV expansion ($200M+ capital project), including construction-in-progress accounting

**ERP Systems & Process Improvement**

•        Utilize SAP Business One to maintain accurate financial records and facilitate efficient accounting workflows

•        Document existing accounting processes and identify opportunities for efficiency gains and automation

•        Assist in the development of standard operating procedures (SOPs) for key finance processes

**Administrative & Cross-Functional Support**

•        Provide general support to the CFO and Finance team on ad hoc financial analysis, data gathering, and reporting projects

•        Assist with budget preparation and financial forecasting

•        Participate in cross-functional collaboration with Operations, Quality, and Supply Chain teams to understand cost drivers and support business decision-making

•        Onsite attendance required—being physically present at work on a regular basis is considered a critical part of performing the job duties

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

•        Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Commerce from an accredited institution (B.S. in Commerce with Accounting concentration from UVA McIntire School of Commerce or equivalent program preferred)

•        Foundational knowledge of U.S. GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles) and familiarity with GAAS (Generally Accepted Auditing Standards)

•        Coursework or understanding of cost accounting principles, including COGS, standard costing, and variance analysis

•        Prior exposure to or aptitude for working with ERP and accounting software (e.g., SAP Business One, QuickBooks, or similar systems)

•        Proficient in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, data validation, conditional formatting, and basic financial modeling)

•        Strong fundamental accounting knowledge including the full general ledger cycle, accrual-basis accounting, and double-entry bookkeeping

•        Strong attention to detail with an aptitude for reconciling data and identifying discrepancies

•        Effective written and verbal communication skills

•        Ability to handle confidential financial information with discretion

•        Must be eligible to work in the United States

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

•        CPA-eligible or intent to pursue CPA licensure (Virginia requires 150 credit hours—McIntire’s M.S. in Accounting program is an excellent path to eligibility)

•        Completion of Intermediate Accounting I & II, Introductory Auditing, Federal Taxation, or Strategic Cost Management coursework

•        Prior internship experience in public accounting, corporate accounting, or financial services

•        Familiarity with pharmaceutical or manufacturing accounting environments

•        Coursework or interest in revenue recognition (ASC 606), manufacturing accounting, or supply chain cost management

•        Experience with or interest in process automation, workflow improvement, and ERP system optimization

•        Basic understanding of internal controls, segregation of duties, and SOX-like compliance frameworks

**WHAT YOU WILL GAIN**

•        Direct mentorship from a CPA/CFO with 30+ years of experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing, M&A, capital project management, and financial operations

•        Hands-on ERP experience in SAP Business One—a system used by thousands of small and mid-size manufacturers globally

•        Exposure to a regulated cGMP environment, including FDA compliance considerations that affect financial processes and documentation

•        Deep understanding of the sterile fill-finish CDMO business model, including milestone-based revenue recognition under ASC 606, batch costing, and manufacturing economics

•        Participation in a company undergoing transformational growth ($200M+ facility expansion, new isolator-based filling line technology, headcount growth)

•        Career-building experience in a PE-backed company where finance is integral to strategic and operational decision-making

•        Foundation for CPA exam preparation and advancement into senior accounting, controllership, or finance leadership roles

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

Afton Scientific is a mission-driven organization that manufactures life-saving injectable pharmaceuticals. Our culture is collaborative, fast-paced, and quality-focused. As a small company (~100 employees currently, growing significantly), team members at every level have direct visibility to leadership and meaningful impact on outcomes. This is not a back-office accounting role—you will be embedded in a working finance team that directly supports a growing pharmaceutical manufacturer, with exposure to every facet of the business from manufacturing operations to client contracts to capital projects.
